blocks.html: Hoisting equipment and material handling equipment, including supports and runback structures, shall be maintained and repaired in compliance with the manufacturer's specifications, the requirements of this code, and rules promulgated by the commissioner. If there is a discrepancy, the stricter requirement shall be met.
